verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a rich official developer toolkit for AI-native builders — an MCP server for agent-driven API access, an installable Link CLI, 'Agent skills' for coding agents, restricted API keys (RAKs) recommended for agent use, and a CLI-provisioned sandbox — all first-party and agent-legible (e.g. llms-full docs). This substantiates 'build against official tooling' for agentic commerce, though it centers on protocol/CLI/MCP tooling rather than traditional multi-language client SDKs (stripe-node/python/etc.) being explicitly framed for AI-native use in this evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of traditional official SDK libraries (not just CLI/MCP) marketed for AI-native development, and independent hands-on developer corroboration of SDK usability.
